mapping.rule: ConfigWarning/DeprecationNotice with nonempty details serialize as summary + space + opening parenthesis + details + closing parenthesis; Warning forwards message; ModelRerouted has a dynamic format. Upstream type is not retained.

exact_candidates.scope: Exact expansion only for the already configured model; not evidence that this notice occurred.
exact_candidates.text: Model metadata for `gpt-6.1-sol` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata; this can degrade performance and cause issues.

exact_candidates.scope: Only a public example expansion; no evidence that the actual configured service tier is priority.
exact_candidates.text: Configured service tier `priority` is not advertised as supported for model `gpt-6.1-sol` and will be omitted from requests.

Code Mode is enabled in configuration, but model `gpt-6.1-sol` does not advertise Code Mode support. This may degrade model performance. Disable `features.code_mode` and `features.code_mode_only`, or select a model whose metadata enables Code Mode.
Stop hook requested continuation without a prompt; ignoring the block.
Heads up: Long threads and multiple compactions can cause the model to be less accurate. Start a new thread when possible to keep threads small and targeted.

`[features.guardianv2].thread_context` is deprecated and ignored. (Thread-owned Guardian context is always enabled. Remove `thread_context` from [features.guardianv2] in config.toml, including profile overrides.)
`[features].transcript_v2` is deprecated and ignored. (Use `[tui].fullscreen_transcript` in config.toml instead.)

dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.template: Code Mode is unavailable because {error}. {behavior}; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.
dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.reason: error is dynamic; behavior has two public choices. Do not use prefix or length to treat this as an exact match.

dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.template: Falling back from WebSockets to HTTPS transport. {err:#}
dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.reason: Dynamic error may contain endpoint/path/service text; no raw suffix may be logged or admitted.

dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.template: Failed to save the conversation transcript; Codex will continue retrying. Error: {err}
dynamic_templates_not_exact_rules.reason: Dynamic persistence error must remain unknown without separately reviewed complete fixed text.

policy.matching: Whole original UTF-8 text equality only; no lowercasing, trim, prefix, regex expansion, or length-only matching.
policy.output: Only fixed rule ID, source version, byte count and existing safe metadata. No text, path, endpoint or secret values.
policy.effect: Diagnostic classification only. All item.error notifications remain blocked; no fallback, retry, provider/model change, or enabling tools.
policy.coverage: Bounded reviewed sources, not an exhaustive inventory.
